body: The reading on 186 includes i=0, whereas 184 writes the corresponding vanishing for i≥1 and 188 again specifies the positive divided powers. In the concrete base \(S=\mathbb Z\), \(X_0^{(0)}=1\) and the S-algebra augmentation sends 1 to 1, so the literal bound on 186 also demands \(1=0\). This gives a precise reading question supported by the explicit unit map; the context’s augmentation discussion suggests the standard positive-ideal formulation but has not been used to alter the frozen text. Confidence is high for this unit calculation and for the visibly retained bound, with the author’s intended correction left to a future reading.
